item.description: Overview of Haggai - Rebuilding What Matters Most Opening Story # For as long as anyone could remember, the Anderson family had talked about home. Not the small apartment they lived in now, nor the temporary places they had occupied over the years, but the old family property lost in a terrible fire a decade earlier. The grandparents spoke about it often. At dinner tables and family gatherings, they told stories of the house that once stood there, the life they had shared, and the dream that one day they would return to rebuild what they had lost.
